item.prompt: Equipment currently in place at home

guidance: A sufficient answer lists the equipment in place and where it is fitted. 'They put some bits in' is not sufficient.
utterance: I genuinely don't know and there's no way for me to find out — the occupational therapist fitted it all while I was in hospital and I've no paperwork.
label: declined
why: Clear unable-to-answer with no route to the information.
